title: Final Answers
description: Essential Criteria: Provide correct qualitative descriptions of the effects of perturbations on the orbit.

title: Polar Flattening Effect
description: Important Criteria: Explain how the non-central gravitational force affects the satellite's angular momentum and orbit shape.

title: Atmospheric Drag Impact
description: Important Criteria: Describe how atmospheric drag alters the satellite's energy and leads to orbit decay.

title: Torque Explanation
description: Optional Criteria: Discuss the role of torque in the precession of the angular momentum vector.

title: Units and Terminology
description: Optional Criteria: Use appropriate physics terminology and units throughout the explanation.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Avoid misrepresenting the effects of perturbations as negligible or incorrectly describing the orbit's final state.
